input.summary:
Camelback kitchen furnished in parts/room-6.mjs: furnace (z14) and smoker (z15) lit on the west wall, a barrel store with a stacked barrel on z16, a two-cell spruce table with one chair at x17, and two hanging lanterns from the y7 ceiling. The door cell x17 z14 and the stair column x19 are left clear.
Room check: 11/11 floor cells lit, min light 9, 0 dark cells, FIT OK for the room. Walk is OK from the door cell (checked with a temp rooms file, entrance [17,3,14]); from the real entrance it reports unreachable only because the Camelback front room is still a stub in this copy.
make.sh produced a whole build.nbt (3151 cells) with 11 placements in my part and no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE lines; the room.png view reads as a small kitchen with stove, table and chair.

waste.what: Learned the layers() row format by trial: rows are single strings per z-row, not nested arrays, and a single layer is one array of strings; first draft had nested arrays and a wrong edit.
waste.cost: 1 failed write plus 1 rewrite, about 2 minutes
waste.tool: layers() doc example in the build library could show one single-layer call with the exact shape; or a helper room_furnish(g, origin, legend, rows) that accepts strings and checks row widths.

waste.what: Walk verdict from the real entrance says unreachable because the front room is still a stub, so I hand-wrote a temp rooms file with the entrance moved to the door to verify the walk.
waste.cost: 1 extra file and 1 extra room run, about 1 minute
waste.tool: mcd room --entrance x,y,z (or --from-door option) so a room can be checked from its own doorway while neighbouring parts are unbuilt.

waste.what: Worked out which cells are the locked stair column and the door front by reading the plan grid by eye, since plan grid shows stair cells as free '.' in a stub copy.
waste.tool: mcd plan could mark the stair flight cells (from the stairs part's reserved list) as 'S' so furnishing avoids them.

companions.task: Check the lantern spots against the light map before placing them; I placed two hanging lanterns by reasoning and only confirmed min light 9 after the build.
Finish the stove's flue and mantle (the plan's stone mantle over the furnace and the west wall breast) so the stove reads as built into the chimney rather than set against a bare wall.

left: The walk from the real entrance can't be confirmed until the Camelback front room (parts/room-5.mjs) is built: the door cell x17 z13 links to it.
No stone mantle or flue breast over the stove; that belongs to the chimney part (P5), which stands the chimney outside the west wall.
plan.md has no checklist box for this room, and the matching elements.md item (stove by the west wall, P5) is the chimney part's, so I did not tick anything.
